prompts.title: Personal information
prompts.prompt: Talk about yourself for 30 seconds. Say your name, your age, where you live and what you do.
prompts.sample: My name is Maria and I am 14 years old. I live in Madrid with my parents and my brother. I am a student at a secondary school. In my free time I like reading and playing basketball.

prompts.title: Your daily routine
prompts.prompt: Describe your daily routine for 45 seconds. Say what time you get up, what you do in the morning and afternoon, and what you do in the evening.
prompts.sample: I get up at 7 o'clock. I have breakfast and then I go to school by bus. My classes start at 8:30. In the afternoon, I do my homework and then I play football. In the evening, I have dinner at 8 and I go to bed at 10.

prompts.title: Your family
prompts.prompt: Describe your family for 45 seconds. Say how many people there are, their names and ages, and something about each person.
prompts.sample: There are four people in my family. My father is 45 and he works in a bank. My mother is 42 and she is a teacher. My sister is 10 years old and she likes dancing. I am the oldest. We are a very close family.

prompts.title: Your free time
prompts.prompt: Talk about your free time for 45 seconds. Say what you like doing, what you don't like, and what you usually do at the weekend.
prompts.sample: In my free time I like listening to music and watching films. I love playing video games, but I don't like sports very much. At the weekend, I usually meet my friends in the park. Sometimes we go to the cinema.

prompts.title: Your last holiday
prompts.prompt: Talk about your last holiday for 45 seconds. Say where you went, who you went with, what you did and what the weather was like.
prompts.sample: Last summer I went to the beach in Valencia with my family. We stayed for one week. We swam in the sea every day and ate paella in a restaurant. The weather was sunny and hot. I took a lot of photos. It was a fantastic holiday.

prompts.title: Your favourite food
prompts.prompt: Talk about your favourite food for 30 seconds. Say what it is, who cooks it, when you eat it, and why you like it.
prompts.sample: My favourite food is pizza. My mother makes it on Saturdays. She uses tomatoes, cheese and ham. I love it because it is delicious and we eat it together as a family. It is my favourite day of the week.

prompts.title: Describing a picture
prompts.prompt: Describe this picture for 1 minute. Talk about what you see, who is in the picture, what they are doing and how they feel.
prompts.sample: In this picture I can see a family in a park. There are four people: a mother, a father and two children. The mother is sitting on a bench and reading a book. The father is playing with a ball with the children. They look happy. The weather is sunny. In the background there are trees and a small lake. It looks like a nice day.
tips: Describe position (in the background, on the left)

prompts.title: Describing a room
prompts.prompt: Describe your bedroom for 1 minute. Say what furniture there is, what colour the walls are, and what you like about your room.
prompts.sample: My bedroom is small but comfortable. There is a bed, a desk and a wardrobe. The walls are blue and there are posters on them. There is a lamp on the desk and a bookshelf next to the bed. I like my room because it is quiet and I can study there. From the window I can see the garden.

prompts.title: Comparing two activities
prompts.prompt: Talk about two activities for 1 minute: reading books and watching TV. Which do you prefer and why?
prompts.sample: I prefer reading books to watching TV. I think books are more interesting because you can imagine the story in your head. Watching TV is easier, but sometimes there is nothing good on. However, I also like watching films in the evening with my family. In my opinion, both activities are good, but reading is better for your brain.

prompts.title: Plans for next weekend
prompts.prompt: Talk about your plans for next weekend for 1 minute. Say what you are going to do, who you are going to be with, and why.
prompts.sample: Next weekend I am going to visit my grandparents. We are going to have lunch together and then we are going to play cards. I am also going to meet my friends on Saturday afternoon to go to the cinema. We are going to see a new comedy. I think it will be a great weekend.
tips: Use time expressions (on Saturday, next weekend)
Mention people you will be with
